description: Check whether an address or transaction hash matches a blacklist (Tether freezes / OFAC sanctions / phishing scams). Returns match type, source, and evidence. TRON coverage includes 9,000+ Tether freeze addresses plus a multi-chain OFAC list. Use to judge whether funds are tainted or safe to receive. 中文：检测地址或交易哈希是否命中黑名单（Tether 冻结 / OFAC 制裁 / 钓鱼诈骗），返回命中类型、来源与证据。TRON 覆盖 9000+ Tether 冻结地址 + OFAC 多链制裁。用于判断资金是否涉黑、能否安全接收。

address.description: Address to check (0x- or T-prefixed). Use either this or txhash

chain.description: Chain. Defaults to auto-detect. Options: bsc / ethereum / base / arbitrum / tron. 中文：链，默认 auto 自动识别，可选 bsc / ethereum / base / arbitrum / tron

txhash.description: Transaction hash. Use either this or address
